dedupe_keys.name: evraz zsmk blast furnace process sensors and labelled operating states

description: This collection records blast-furnace process conditions at the West-Siberian Metal Plant in Novokuznetsk, Russia. Process-control researchers combine measurements from twenty-six sensors with laboratory silicon measurements and an ore-to-coke ratio from the dispatch system. Variables include gas composition and pressure, blast flow and temperatures, sampled at one-hour intervals according to the article. Mendeley supplies a raw workbook, a smaller checked and class-labelled workbook, and attribute documentation free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage is one plant; exact calendar endpoints were not established. Gross outliers in raw readings and the distinction between sensor observations and laboratory or calculated fields are limitations for model fitting. Modellers could calibrate process-state predictors or investigate operating uncertainty in industrial digital-twin simulations. platform-aspen-plus-process-simulation is a related process-modelling environment requiring separate furnace configuration. No workbook values were downloaded, and no operational forecast or safety-control claim was independently tested.
